__setup_instructions__.step1_import: In n8n: Workflows → Import from File → select this n8n_workflow.json
__setup_instructions__.step2_credentials: Settings → Credentials → Add Gmail OAuth2. Paste the credential ID into the two Gmail nodes.
__setup_instructions__.step3_paths: Replace all occurrences of /path/to/pharma-pipeline with your actual project path (3 places in ExecuteCommand and WriteBinaryFile nodes).
__setup_instructions__.step4_emails: Update REPORT_RECIPIENT and ADMIN_EMAIL in the 'Set Environment Variables' node.
__setup_instructions__.step5_activate: Toggle the workflow to Active. It will first run at 07:00 tomorrow.
__setup_instructions__.step6_test: Click 'Execute Workflow' to run a manual test immediately.
